content.body: I made a doodle for a new standing meeting time: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/17F7yzfRfrGAerVqIuadEYwOAW9L61ToWxfK1svH5s7s/edit?gid=1732521924#gid=1732521924
gonna go ahead and merge a bunch of things I've reviewed to my satisfaction and no one has had further comments on
also: at some point it would be nice to document what CI means
and which things are supposed to be blocking
I have been basically ignoring the circleci jobs
also also: I have turned off merge commits since we don't appear to use them and I don't want to accidentally click that button (and also because they're awful)
these fail when esvu fails to install an engine, which is confusing to say the least
I opened an issue some time ago to improve the usefulness of those jobs: https://github.com/tc39/test262/issues/4118
I've been meaning to see if I could get a halfway decent solution to that with an LLM, but haven't had the chance yet. maybe that's something for this week

de facto, the things that are marked in the workflow as blocking, are the blocking things 😄 we can certainly discuss whether that should change. for example, I ran into "lint all tests" blocking on Monday, I didn't realize we had set that one to be blocking (rather than "lint new/changed tests")
